mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_schedules (job_id, schedule_date, start_time, end_time, slots_available) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{slotsAvailable})
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, schedule_date, start_time, end_time, slots_available, contact_name, contact_phone, status FROM job_schedules WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC

SELECT id, job_id, schedule_date, start_time, end_time, slots_available, contact_name, contact_phone, status FROM job_schedules WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC
SELECT id, job_id, schedule_date, start_time, end_time, slots_available, contact_name, contact_phone, status FROM job_schedules WHERE id = #{id}
